name: Defender for Cloud / Defender for Cloud alerts in Defender XDR
text:
// Adapted from the AlertInfo and AlertEvidence schema reference on Microsoft Learn (https://learn.microsoft.com/defender-xdr/advanced-hunting-alertinfo-table).
AlertInfo
| where Timestamp > ago({Lookback})
| where ServiceSource == "Microsoft Defender for Cloud"
| summarize arg_max(Timestamp, *) by AlertId
| join kind=leftouter (
    AlertEvidence
    | where Timestamp > ago({Lookback})
    | where isnotempty(ResourceID)
    | summarize Resources = make_set(ResourceID, 10) by AlertId
  ) on AlertId
| project Timestamp, Severity, Title, Category, AttackTechniques, DetectionSource, Resources, AlertId
| order by Timestamp desc
